summary.text: Omar McCrorey is the Democratic candidate for South Carolina House of Representatives District 46 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican incumbent Heath Sessions.
A U.S. Army veteran who served from 1998 to 2004, he lists his profession as executive director.

paragraphs.text: Omar McCrorey earned a high school diploma from Northwestern High School and an associate degree from Everest University in 2015.
His Ballotpedia survey describes him as a 45-year-old husband, father of two daughters and 100% disabled Operation Iraqi Freedom Army veteran who lives in York County.
In the survey, McCrorey said he intends to focus on policies that strengthen families, support veterans, address healthcare and improve economic opportunity in District 46.

He listed consumer protection, child welfare and family stability, veteran services, supporting law enforcement, government accountability, and economic opportunity and workforce development among his policy areas.
